summary: Recorded receipt 791d25b96017428eb74a6280f460203e, the repeat of the real-prefix boundary experiment from its retained inputs. All three prefixes behaved as in the first run: the fifty-batch tail (3199 entries, staged commit 3401) returned in 2 ms, exactly 128 batches (8192 entries, staged commit 8394) returned in 5 ms, and 129 batches (8194 entries, staged commit 8396) did not return within 20 s with one goroutine parked in processLogs. The account keeps its violated conclusion and asserted defect claim and now records that the pair differing by a single committed entry has been run twice with the same outcome, so the boundary no longer rests on a single execution of that harness. The counterevidence entry about snapshot-bounded replay and the limitation describing the real-prefix sampling both note the second run and its timings, the joint history records that this is a repeat of the same fixed experiment sharing its cases, admissions and assertions, and both startup knowledge entries gain the receipt, knowledge-0 on the three case events and knowledge-1 on the three result events.
